carrier.H_t_definition: H_t(z)=int_0^infty exp(t u^2) Phi(u) cos(z u) du
carrier.Lambda_definition: inf{t in R: all zeros of H_t are real}
carrier.residual: Xi_DBN=max(Lambda,0) after Rodgers-Tao Lambda>=0; closure Lambda<=0 equivalently Lambda=0
carrier.closure: Lambda=0 iff RH, using Rodgers-Tao lower bound plus de Bruijn-Newman equivalence

CRE_audit.claim: RH iff Lambda <= 0; Rodgers-Tao proves Lambda >= 0; hence RH iff Lambda = 0
CRE_audit.notes: Closure is target-equivalent to RH, not a weaker native theorem.

bounds.bound_or_result: monotonicity/real-zero persistence under heat flow; real zeros for sufficiently large t

bounds.bound_or_result: existence of finite Lambda threshold; Newman conjecture Lambda>=0
